# North Foster Farm

> A small family farm in Foster, Rhode Island, raising chickens on
> pasture for eggs and meat. Sold at three weekly farmers markets, for
> pickup at the farm, and by local delivery through online ordering at
> https://www.northfosterfarm.com/order.

The birds live outside on grass, move to fresh pasture regularly, and
eat feed free of GMOs. Products: pasture-raised eggs by the dozen,
whole chickens by weight, chicken parts, ground chicken, chicken
sausage, and seasonal pork. Orders are paid by a Square invoice sent
by email; nothing is charged at the time of ordering.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.northfosterfarm.com/): what the farm is, how to
  buy, and the latest update
- [Order](https://www.northfosterfarm.com/order/): current stock and
  prices, on-farm pickup, market pickup, and local delivery
- [About](https://www.northfosterfarm.com/about/): the farm, the
  family, and the markets with days, hours and addresses
- [Delivery policy](https://www.northfosterfarm.com/delivery-policy/):
  delivery area, minimums, fees and bulk discounts
